user.title: Create a PT Alarm panel
user.description: Give your alarm panel a name. You can add a first user code now, or add users later from the integration's **Configure** menu.

data_description.code: At least 4 characters. Digits-only codes give you a numeric keypad.

error.code_too_short: The code must be at least 4 characters.

abort.already_configured: A panel with this name already exists.

init.title: PT Alarm configuration
init.description: {sensors} sensor(s) and {users} user(s) configured. Make your changes, then choose **Save and close**.

data.auto_bypass: Automatically bypass open sensors when arming
data.disarm_after_trigger: Disarm after the trigger time ends
data.max_attempts: Invalid code attempts before lockout (0 = never)

mode_settings.title: Mode: {mode}
mode_settings.description: Exit delay: time to leave after arming. Entry delay: time to disarm after a delayed sensor opens. Trigger time: how long the alarm stays triggered (0 = until disarmed).

sensor_add.title: Add sensors
sensor_add.description: Choose sensors and a type. Each type has sensible defaults that you can fine-tune afterwards with **Edit a sensor**.

data.always_on: Always on (24 hours, even when disarmed)

user_add.title: Add a user code
user_add.description: Codes are stored hashed and cannot be read back.

data_description.notify_services: For example notify.mobile_app_my_phone. Custom values are allowed.

error.code_too_short: The code must be at least 4 characters.
error.user_exists: A user with this name already exists.

arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arm a PT Alarm panel, with optional force arming and delay skipping.

force.name: Force
force.description: Arm even when sensors are open; the open sensors are bypassed.

skip_delay.name: Skip exit delay
skip_delay.description: Arm immediately without the exit delay.

mode_not_enabled.message: Arm mode {mode} is not enabled for this panel.

disarm_first.message: The alarm is triggered. Disarm it first.

open_sensors.message: Cannot arm, these sensors are open: {sensors}

not_allowed.message: This user is not allowed to do that.

locked_out.message: Too many invalid codes. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
